title: manni citations strict (1.0.0-proposal.1)
description: The strict overlay for manni:citations:1.0.0-proposal.4. Stack it beside the open draft, which still owns every key and every required rule. It asks for the full commit hash a tool writes, and it pairs the pin's prefix with the source file.

citations.description: Strict narrows each entry's `source`. An encrypted `file` takes an `hmac-sha256-` pin, a plain one takes a `sha256-` pin, and `commit-sha` is a full hash.

commit-sha.description: A full commit hash, forty lowercase hex digits or sixty-four in a SHA-256 repository.
